name: vlm_shape_benchmark
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating vision-language models on shape recognition and shape-based reasoning tasks. It tests models' abilities to identify, compare and reason about basic geometric shapes and spatial relations from images and paired questions/prompts. Useful for probing low-level visual reasoning and VLM compositionality.
reputation: A small, focused dataset used by researchers probing VLM visual reasoning; modest adoption compared to larger VQA or general VLM benchmarks.
